priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore message listener cleanup
findings.body: The returned function previously removed the registered handler via socket.off. It now does nothing, so callers cannot detach after teardown and will continue receiving messages; repeated attachment cycles can also accumulate duplicate callbacks and retain associated state.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) on line 2 but the returned cleanup on changed line 3 is empty. Calling cleanup therefore leaves the listener active, causing continued/duplicate handling and retained closures across attach/cleanup cycles.
